_comment: mix_v4 DRAFT, 2026-08-30. NOT wired as any default -- train.py's Cfg.mix still points at mix_v3.json until the team approves this for training. The one settled change is textbook 0.36 -> 0.12; everything else is reallocated to the real-text domains in their v3 proportions (the same rule data/mix_v3_lowtb.json used; in a production mix, 'freed share goes to real text' is intended behavior -- the lowtb confound was only a problem in the two-arm A/B, not here). Stays a draft until the ARCHITECTURE settles (AttnRes validation, untie), because total token budget and domain weights change once the throughput tax and re-tokenization are decided. Structural comments carried over from v3.
_textbook_0.12_basis: Why 0.12, and why it is NOT 'synthetic is harmful'. docs/synthetic_data_standard.md criterion 6 is CONFOUNDED (mix_v3_lowtb reallocated freed weight to real-text, so tb05 had ~31% less textbook AND ~31% more web; scoring on web/wiki holdout measured an arm trained on more web -- a tautology). What the measurement DOES support: at a fixed token budget, web's marginal value exceeds the seed-diluted synthetic's. That, plus the hand-read 15% confident-false-claims and 32% fiction in the textbook domain (docs/audit_cosmopedia.md), sets textbook at 0.12 (0.40B of 3.3B). This number would change toward ~0 IF an equal-exposure design ever shows the synthetic actively harms the representation (task #38), and the reason would be 'synthetic harmful' rather than 'web worth more' -- update this note, not the guidance, when that runs.
_pending: Four open items gate anything beyond the textbook cut: (1) web_edu (Fineweb-Edu-Chinese-V2.1 4_5): EVALUATED, DEFERRED. 22.9B tokens / 17.8h push, buys the only domain that does not cap (web_hq 1.73 epoch uncapped; math 4 epoch and code pool-capped are the genuinely hungry ones), coverage is not the current binding constraint (today's diagnosis is exposure bias, a dynamics problem, not data-quantity), and architecture is unsettled -- ingesting before architecture means re-tokenizing if untie lands and buying fewer-equal tokens if AttnRes is switched off (+45% throughput). Re-eval trigger, not 'later': all three A/Bs done AND one measurement that coverage is the constraint (web_hq epoch pushed past 2 and still improving, or a scaling comparison showing the current corpus saturating). (2) CCI4.0-M2-CoT math-high: PENDING MIGRATION TEST (2026-08-30, promoted back to candidate -- language is NOT a disqualifier; the mix has an en domain, math reasoning is largely language-independent, and math is the genuinely-hungry domain). Anchored: numbers-subset 96% (n=200, residual are derived intermediates), 0 eval-holdout hits in 200,000 rows (caveat: English-math slice vs our Chinese eval holdout), ~1.1% 200-char-prefix repetition, 217K rows, 1.9GB in hand; full 69.7GB download paused. Weight set by the migration test: does a 500-step English-math-Co arm MOVE Chinese math (k8 base math-hard 0.0%)? It shuts the en/math door one way or the other. Do NOT translate (translation re-risks numbers/entities-not-subset); feed as en/math directly. Disqualifiers are only contamination / anchoring failure / overlap with existing corpus / transport cost -- language is not one. Cost to weight: English fertility 1.429 vs Chinese 1.693 chars/token, so English dilutes Chinese exposure per token. (3) Equal-exposure criterion-6 (#38) won't change 0.12 per current reasoning. (4) ANNEAL WEIGHTS ARE UNMEASURED: the per-domain anneal values have no controlled experiment behind them; anneal_frac=0.10 is within the evidence range (MiniCPM ~1.4% / SmolLM2 9% / Cosmopedia 4%) but the per-domain split is inherited from v3, unmeasured. Do not read these as designed.
_notes: epoch cap: code caps (pool small); scheduled 3.18B of 3.30B. web_hq fits (epochs 1.73 < cap 2). code's cap matches v3's intent that a weight past the pool's capacity reads as a cap, not a repeat.
